name: uberasm-ultimate-controller-based-switch-v1
title: Ultimate Controller-Based Switch v1.0
description:
This very flexible piece of code allows you to easily setup a ON-OFF kind of switch changed by controller input... or more ! You can have up to 8 of them at the same time. Details in .asm file.

Default configuration replicates the classic "Spin to switch ON-OFF status" effect.
